name: Void Crystal Shard
description: A fragment broken from a void-crystal formation in the dungeon depths. The System classifies it as ANOMALOUS.
flavor_text: It hums at a frequency you feel in your fillings.

name: Matriarch Silk
description: A coil of crystal-threaded silk spun by a brood matriarch. Tougher than steel wire and half the weight.
flavor_text: It still twitches when the light catches it.

name: Phylactery Shard
description: A sliver of the vessel a dead wizard poured himself into. The System tags it UNSTABLE: SOUL RESIDUE.
flavor_text: Sometimes, when you are almost asleep, it whispers your name back to you.

name: Pale Lamp Oil
description: Consecrated oil from the lamps of the Order of the Pale Lamp. Restores 40 MP when drunk.
flavor_text: It burns cold going down. Whatever the priests prayed to, it was listening.
